title: Auditoria editorial e canônica TG-H — 47 registros incluídos em 24/10/2026

scope.time_window: Commit date 24 October, even for older event dates

findings.core_trilingual_fields: 47/47 with titles, cards and context non-empty PT/EN/ES

strengths: Event/publication dates generally separate; unknown dates explicit
Strong caveats for eggs versus live animals, parts versus animals, kg versus animal count
Route itinerary, intended movement, administrative custody and provenance differentiated
Most records contextualize neighboring duplicates and protect against unrelated cross-border claims
Sources usually attributed to authorities, with occasional official primary links
deficiencies: Secondary notes in English and Spanish had been absent or copied from PT; translation pass applied to 46 cases
F1–F7 source hierarchy not structurally stored across every record
Some EN/ES context blocks are shorter than PT and deserve fuller semantic parity, beyond presence checks
Several scientific taxon fields used invalid rank + spp. or vernacular + spp.; five corrected now
Some source URLs point to news accounts rather than involved agency's primary publication
The website's rendering of all locale fields and source links has not been visually audited

priority_reviews.reason: Earlier 14 Sep boat possibly differs from October AFMA case; event_date nulled pending vessel ID
Ensure exclude_from_totals=true, 70 animals from nationwide aggregate not added to individual case totals
Case ID suggests 22 Oct but source reports event day unclear; reptile interception distinct from 5 Oct pangolin scales
Multiple countries of passenger origin not mapped to each seized item
Potential unit value and China nationality must not be treated as verified destination/network
Country of border crossing not biological provenance of turtle
320 vs 320.85 kg discrepancy; distribution endpoints not proven movement of seized lot
April 2025 search, October 2026 verdict; preserve non-exact combined animal count
Animal group and number unknown; source says suspected bushmeat
Multi-location 28 + 30 + 21 kg aggregate, do not count subevents twice
Destination Barreiros only intended and not reached

rules_to_implement: Make all displayed localized fields required for PT/EN/ES, including quantity, route and source notes
Implement semantic parity review, not just nonempty checks
Validate event_date independently from publication date and avoid assigning exact days based on possible matches
Require genus for standard 'sp.' or 'spp.' expressions, otherwise use formal taxon rank without spp.
Record source tier, directness, event timestamp and uncertainty as structured fields
Record route leg as completed/intended/alleged/custody and only map documented source-supported movements
Suppress aggregate entries from animal totals whenever individual cases may overlap
limitations: Editorial GitHub-data audit; each external source and the live website display were not individually revalidated by visual browsing.
